title: Parallelograms, Special Quadrilaterals and Polygon Angles
seo_title: Geometry Quadrilaterals and Polygon Angles Worksheets (TEKS G.6E)
standard_text: G.6E prove a quadrilateral is a parallelogram, rectangle, square, or rhombus using opposite sides, opposite angles, or diagonals and apply these relationships to solve problems; G.5A investigate patterns to make conjectures about geometric relationships, including diagonals of quadrilaterals and interior and exterior angles of polygons
meta_desc: Free Geometry worksheets for Texas TEKS G.6E and G.5A: polygon angle sums, parallelograms, rectangles, rhombuses, squares, trapezoids and kites. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Rhombus diagonals are perpendicular; rectangle diagonals are equal.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Interior angles of an n-gon add to 180°(n − 2). Exterior angles add to 360°.
  • Parallelogram: opposite sides and angles are congruent; diagonals bisect each other.
  • Rectangle: congruent diagonals. Rhombus: perpendicular diagonals. Square: both.
  • To prove a parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides congruent or parallel, or diagonals bisect each other.

Examples

Example

Interior angle of a regular octagon

180 × 6 = 1080

1080 ÷ 8

Answer: 135°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using 180nThe sum is 180(n − 2).
Thinking every parallelogram has equal diagonalsOnly rectangles do.
Calling every rhombus a squareA square also needs right angles.

items.q: What is the measure of each exterior angle of a regular 18-gon?
items.e: The exterior angles of any polygon add to 360°: 360° ÷ 18 = 20°.

items.q: A pentagon has angles of 92°, 104°, 132°, 148° and x°. Find x.

items.q: Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 162°. How many sides does it have?

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AE = 3x + 3 and EC = 4x − 2. Find AC.
items.e: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so AE = EC: 3x + 3 = 4x − 2, so x = 5. AC = 2 × 18 = 36.

items.q: ABCD is a rectangle with diagonals meeting at E. AE = 2x + 8 and BD = 4x + 16. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are congruent and bisect each other, so BD = AC = 2 × AE: 4x + 16 = 2(2x + 8), x = 4.

items.q: ABCD is a rectangle with diagonals meeting at E. AE = 3x + 6 and BD = 4x + 18. Find x.

For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 6x − 2, CD = 4x + 8, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 6x − 2 = 4x + 8, so 2x = 10 and x = 5.

items.q: Is every rhombus a square?
c: Only if it is a trapezoid
items.e: A rhombus is a square only if it has right angles. No, only sometimes.

items.q: Which quadrilateral has two pairs of consecutive congruent sides but opposite sides that are not congruent?
items.e: That is the definition of a kite. Kite.

items.q: A parallelogram has one right angle. What must it be?
items.e: Consecutive angles are supplementary and opposite angles are equal, so all four angles are 90°. A rectangle.

items.q: Which quadrilateral always has perpendicular diagonals?
items.e: Rhombuses (including squares) and kites have perpendicular diagonals. Rhombus.

items.q: Which property does a rectangle have that a general parallelogram does not?
items.e: Every parallelogram has the other three properties. Its diagonals are congruent.

items.q: Which fact is enough to prove ABCD is a parallelogram?
c: Both pairs of opposite angles are congruent
One pair of opposite angles is congruent
items.e: If both pairs of opposite angles are congruent, the quadrilateral is a parallelogram. Both pairs of opposite angles are congruent.

items.q: Is every square a rhombus?
c: Only if its diagonals are not equal
items.e: A square has four congruent sides, which is the definition of a rhombus. Yes, always.

items.q: A parallelogram has perpendicular diagonals. What must it be?
items.e: A parallelogram with perpendicular diagonals is a rhombus. A rhombus.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 4x + 3, CD = 2x + 15, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 4x + 3 = 2x + 15, so 2x = 12 and x = 6.

items.q: Is a rectangle a parallelogram?
c: Only if it is a square
items.e: A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides. Yes, always.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 6x + 5, CD = 3x + 14, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 6x + 5 = 3x + 14, so 3x = 9 and x = 3.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 3x − 4, CD = 2x, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 3x − 4 = 2x, so x = 4.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 5x − 3, CD = 6x − 14, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 5x − 3 = 6x − 14, so x = 11.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 3x + 1, CD = 5x − 23, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 3x + 1 = 5x − 23, so 2x = 24 and x = 12.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 4x + 6, CD = 5x, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 4x + 6 = 5x, so x = 6.

items.q: Which quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
items.e: A trapezoid has exactly one pair of parallel sides (its bases). Trapezoid.

items.q: A parallelogram has congruent diagonals. What must it be?
items.e: A parallelogram with congruent diagonals is a rectangle. A rectangle.

items.q: For what value of x is ABCD a parallelogram, if AB = 4x + 5, CD = 5x − 1, and AB ∥ CD?
items.e: A pair of opposite sides that is parallel and congruent proves a parallelogram. Set AB = CD: 4x + 5 = 5x − 1, so x = 6.

items.q: Which quadrilateral always has diagonals that are congruent?
items.e: Rectangles (including squares) have congruent diagonals. A general rhombus does not. Rectangle.
